labels.reference_not_parseable: 原生参考不可标准解析
labels.prediction_not_parseable: 首选分子不可标准解析
labels.canonical_equivalent: 原串不同、标准分子图等价
labels.hydrogen_charge_radical_state: 重原子图相同，H/电荷/自由基状态不同
labels.heavy_element_composition: 总数量相同、元素组成不同
labels.fragment_allocation: 总体组成相同、条件片段间组成分配不同
labels.connectivity_or_bond_order: 各片段组成相同、连接或键级不同

definitions.hierarchical: First failed comparison in declared order. Mutually exclusive descriptive differences; not unique chemical causes.
definitions.reference: Frozen XYZ-decoded reference used by original official score; standard parsing may fail. Original experimental SMILES remain separately available.
definitions.abstract_heavy_graph: RDKit graph serialization ignoring H, formal charge, radical electrons and stereo, retaining atom element/isotope and bond types. Never used to repair predictions or change metrics.
definitions.fragment_allocation: Overall heavy-element composition agrees but per-conditioned-fragment composition differs. This does not alone prove chemical role reversal.
definitions.overlapping_tags: Nonexclusive observations among the stated comparable native-graph denominator. Ring count is not full ring topology.
definitions.group_counts: SMARTS counts in native decoded graphs, not prevalence in original experimental molecules or proven causal functional-group mechanisms.
